note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). The table must not exist yet for the provision screen (see manual_prepare).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
manual_prepare: Power Apps: create solution MGLabDataverse (publisher prefix mgl, option value prefix 72700) if missing.
Make sure table Project Request (mgl_projectrequest) does not exist (delete it from the solution after a rehearsal).

screens.name: maker-keys
steps: Open Keys: show 'Request Code' on mgl_requestcode with status Active
Open Columns: Budget, Due Date, Priority, Request Code, Customer Account (B-roll)
Open Due Date, Advanced options: Format and Behavior are 'Date only'
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

steps: Select DEV, Apps, open the model-driven app with Project Request (or Tables, Project Request, Data)
Show the Project Requests view: 18 rows, no duplicates
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

manual_teardown: Solution: delete the Project Request table (removes columns, lookup and key), optionally the MGLabDataverse solution (unless episodes 2-4 are next).
Remove any app registration / application user created only for the recording.
